name: 同心轻绽
shape: 三条轻柔开放带面围出中央白莲，双根与礼的点折借自然转接联系。
culture: 莲心留白、带面共接与开放延伸联系善心、善念、善行。
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE NEW contemporary corporate logo SYMBOL for 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO, company 达州礼林生态科技有限责任公司. The client rejected previous marks as too HARD in both COLOR and GEOMETRY. This is a genuine redesign of form and color, not a rigid mark with pastel recoloring. Primary feeling: soft, humane, airy, flowing, confident professional calm. Use curved transitions, lighter mass, moderate chroma, harmonious warm/cool midtones. Keep name-source 礼林 and values 善心善念善行; engineering and software live subtly in SHARED SUPPORT and CONNECTED PATHS. No collage of industry icons. Construction: ONE AIRY ASYMMETRICAL OPEN-FOLD emblem with a LARGE CLEAR WHITE THREE-PETAL LOTUS AT ITS EXACT CENTER. Three gently flowing medium-light bands open around the white flower, NOT a solid rounded square. Their paired soft branching lower stems hint 林, the left soft dot and one graceful open L-turn hint 礼. Outer silhouette almost rounded but intentionally open at TWO sides; move the rhythm through curves rather than block notches. LOTS OF WHITE SPACE, soft terminals, broad channels, medium-light weight, no sharp corner, literal frame, hard prism, rectangle or technical circuit detail. Underlying shared support and open pathway may suggest engineering/software cooperation without literal pictograms. Palette: Quiet blue-to-periwinkle #7D96B6 to #A4AED0, mauve-to-dusty-pink #B39DBE to #CFABBC, small muted apricot #D7B59C accent; flat 2D soft transitions with enough contrast against white. ONE centered standalone emblem on pure WHITE, ample margin. NO company lettering or captions: a neutral wordmark will be consistently added separately. Flat vector-like polished graphic, smooth contours, very restrained 2D gradients permitted, NO 3D, glass, glow, bevels, texture or shadows. NO high-saturation royal blue, bright red, neon lime, red-yellow-blue hard clash, sharp polygon tips, squared I-beams, blocky modules, exposed chips or gears. Do not wash the mark out into nearly invisible pastel, and do not imitate an established brand.
